title: 「The reason why ... is that ...」說明原因
titleZh: 「The reason why ... is that ...」說明原因

source.file: Sentence Structure 186 -「The reason why ... is that ...」說明原因.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: The reason why + subject + verb + is that + subject + verb

formulas.formula: The reason why + subject + verb + is that + subject + verb

example: The reason why many policies fail is that they ignore human behaviour.
exampleZh: 很多政策失敗的原因，是它們忽視了人類行為。

examples.en: The reason why many policies fail is that they ignore human behaviour.
examples.zh: 很多政策失敗的原因，是它們忽視了人類行為。
examples.highlight: The reason why many policies fail is that they ignore human behaviour.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：The reason why + subject + verb + is that + subject + verb。

rules.zh: why 後面的部分應說明「甚麼事情需要解釋」。
rules.en: Put the situation after why The clause after why states the situation that needs to be explained. Correct: The reason why the shop is closed is that it is a public holiday. Incorrect: The reason why is that the shop is closed it is a public holiday.
examples: The clause after why states the situation that needs to be explained.
Correct: The reason why the shop is closed is that it is a public holiday.
Incorrect: The reason why is that the shop is closed it is a public holiday.

rules.zh: 即使句中有 why，也不需要使用問句語序。
rules.en: Use normal statement word order after why The clause after why is not a direct question. Correct: The reason why he left early is that he felt unwell. Incorrect: The reason why did he leave early is that he felt unwell.
examples: Use normal statement word order after why
The clause after why is not a direct question.
Correct: The reason why he left early is that he felt unwell.
Incorrect: The reason why did he leave early is that he felt unwell.

rules.zh: 日常英語中有時會聽到 the reason is because，但在正式寫作中通常建議使用 the reason is that。本練習的所有答案都必須使用 is that。
rules.en: Use is that, not is because, in this exercise Target form: The reason why the lesson started late is that the teacher’s train was delayed. Excluded form in this exercise: The reason why the lesson started late is because the teacher’s train was delayed.
examples: Use is that, not is because, in this exercise
Target form: The reason why the lesson started late is that the teacher’s train was delayed.
The reason why the lesson started late is because the teacher’s train was delayed.

rules.en: Do not omit that In informal conversation, speakers sometimes omit that, but every answer in this exercise must include it. Required: The reason why I called is that I needed help.
examples: In informal conversation, speakers sometimes omit that, but every answer in this exercise must
The reason why I called is that I needed help.

rules.zh: 即使事情發生在過去，也可以使用 is that，因為說話者現在正在解釋原因。was that 在某些過去 敘事中也可以使用，但不屬於本練習的目標形式。
rules.en: Use is that throughout this exercise Even when the event happened in the past, is that can introduce the explanation being given now. The reason why the meeting ended early is that several people had to leave.
examples: Use is that throughout this exercise
Even when the event happened in the past, is that can introduce the explanation being given
The reason why the meeting ended early is that several people had to leave.

benefits.zh: 這個句型把「發生了甚麼事」和「事情發生的原因」清楚分開，讓讀者更容易理解兩者的關係。
benefits.en: It clearly separates the situation from its cause The first part tells the reader what happened. The second part explains why it happened.

benefits.zh: 以 The reason why... 開始句子，可以提醒聽者或讀者：接下來的內容將會解釋一個重要原因。
benefits.en: It places attention on the explanation Beginning with The reason why... tells the listener that an important explanation is coming.

benefits.zh: 在討論、作文、報告和簡報中，這個句型可以幫助你有條理地解釋事情發生的原因。
benefits.en: It helps organise answers and paragraphs This structure is useful when answering questions about causes in discussions, essays, reports and presentations.

benefits.zh: 你不需要每次都使用 because。這個句型可以先提出問題，再集中說明原因，使句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeatedly using because Compare: Many policies fail because they ignore human behaviour. The reason why many policies fail is that they ignore human behaviour. The second sentence presents the problem first and then gives a focused explanation.

benefits.zh: 只要記住這個固定框架，說話時便可以迅速把「情況」和「原因」放入句中，不需要每次重新組織整 個答案。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame Once you remember: The reason why _____ is that _____ you can quickly insert your own situation and explanation.
